title: Industrial Engine Core with Dynamic God Rays and Carbon Fiber Plating
description: The user views a mechanical engine core composed of rotating gears encased in carbon fiber plating, illuminated by volumetric god rays streaming through the assembly. Through a multi-step control panel, users adjust god ray intensity, gear rotation speed, bloom threshold, chromatic aberration, vignette darkness, tone mapping exposure, and carbon fiber reflectivity to craft a cinematic industrial scene.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer post-processing. Load three GLB assets: godrays_demo.glb (use its mesh as a luminous light source emitting volumetric god rays), gears.glb (place as a central rotating mechanical assembly), and CarbonFibre.glb (extract its texture and apply as a MeshPhysicalMaterial with adjustable metalness/roughness to panels surrounding the gears). Position the camera at (0, 2, 6) looking at origin. Add a bright directional light at (3, 5, 2) and a dim ambient light. Set up EffectComposer with RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass (threshold 0.6, strength 1.2, radius 0.4), and ShaderPass for custom god ray screen-space effect using the godrays_demo mesh position projected to screen space. Add a FilmPass for subtle grain and a custom vignette ShaderPass. Animate gears rotating on their Y-axis continuously. Create an HTML control panel overlay with 7 labeled sliders: (1) God Ray Intensity (0-3, default 1.5) controlling the god ray shader uniform, (2) Gear Rotation Speed (0-5 RPM, default 1) controlling animation delta multiplier, (3) Bloom Strength (0-3, default 1.2) adjusting UnrealBloomPass.strength, (4) Bloom Threshold (0-1, default 0.6) adjusting UnrealBloomPass.threshold, (5) Chromatic Aberration Offset (0-0.01, default 0.003) via a custom RGB shift ShaderPass, (6) Vignette Darkness (0-2, default 1.0) adjusting vignette shader uniform, (7) Carbon Fiber Reflectivity (0-1, default 0.7) adjusting the MeshPhysicalMaterial metalness on the surrounding panels. Each slider must validate its range and update the corresponding parameter in real time. Style the panel with a dark semi-transparent background pinned to the right side. The scene background should be dark (0x0a0a0f). Ensure the god ray source mesh glows with emissive material and the bloom pass picks it up naturally, creating visible light shafts across the gear assembly.
